meta.name: PFL
meta.description:
PFL brings the sport format to MMA, where every fight matters on the path to the PFL World Championship and $1 million prize. Catch up on the greatest fights, highlights, and commentary with PFL MMA.

Shows: Fighter Compilation, FAST Specials, Full Fights: Justin Gaethje, Pfl In 60, Bellator Legend Series: Rory MacDonald
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
